# For the first time ever: Earn two Round-Trip Delta Comfort Flights + 50K bonus miles


New limited-time welcome offers make it a great time to apply for a Delta SkyMiles® American Express Card, building on 30 years of added value through new benefits, premium travel experiences and exclusive Card Member access.


Staff Writer


Aug 27, 2026 9:00am


Beginning Aug. 27 through Nov. 4, eligible new Delta SkyMiles® American Express Card Members can take advantage of new limited-time welcome offers across the Card portfolio, including a new first-of-its-kind welcome offer for the Delta SkyMiles® Reserve American Express Consumer Card.


For the first time ever, eligible new Card Members can earn two Round-Trip Delta Comfort Flight Certificates and 50,000 Bonus Miles after spending $10,000 in purchases on their new Card in the first six months. The Flight Certificates have no blackout dates and are valid for eligible round-trip travel on Delta-operated flights within the U.S. 48, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands*.


**A 21+ day advance purchase is required. Taxes and fees up to $80 per person apply. Terms and other restrictions apply.*


**See all limited-time welcome offers**


Beginning Aug. 27 through Nov. 4, 2026, eligible new Delta SkyMiles® American Express Card Members can take advantage of the following limited-time welcome offers:


- For the first time ever, new[Delta SkyMiles® Reserve American Express Card](https://www.americanexpress.com/us/credit-cards/card/delta-skymiles-reserve-american-express-card/?eep=25330&intlink=US-Axp-Shop-Consumer-VAC-DeltaReserve-Prospect-Viewdetails-CardTile&inav=menu_cards_pc_travelrewardscards) Members can earn two round-trip Delta Comfort Flight Certificates and 50,000 Bonus Miles after spending $10,000 in purchases on their new Card in the first six months *. Flight Certificates have no blackout dates. Flight Certificates valid for Delta Comfort or Delta Main to eligible destinations within the U.S. 48, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands, booked 21+ days in advance; up to $80 per person in taxes/fees apply. Other restrictions apply *.*


- New **[Delta SkyMiles® Reserve Business American Express Card](https://www.americanexpress.com/en-us/business/credit-cards/delta-skymiles-reserve/?linknav=US-Acq-GCP-BusinessCards-ViewAllCards-LearnMore-DeltaReserve) Members can earn 200,000 Bonus Miles after spending $20,000 in purchases on their new Card in the first six months.*; this is the highest Bonus Miles offer this year.


- New[Delta SkyMiles® Platinum American Express Card](https://www.americanexpress.com/us/credit-cards/card/delta-skymiles-platinum-american-express-card/?eep=25330&intlink=US-Axp-Shop-Consumer-VAC-DeltaPlatinum-Prospect-Viewdetails-CardTile&inav=menu_cards_pc_travelrewardscards) Members can apply and find out their welcome offer which could be as high as 90,000 Bonus Miles, plus a $300 Statement Credit as a limited time offer after spending $4,000 in purchases on their new Card in the first six months*.


- New[Delta SkyMiles® Platinum Business American Express Card](https://www.americanexpress.com/en-us/business/credit-cards/delta-skymiles-platinum/?linknav=US-Acq-GCP-BusinessCards-ViewAllCards-LearnMore-DeltaPlatinum) Members can earn 100,000 Bonus Miles after spending $8,000 in purchases on their new Card in the first six months*.


- New[Delta SkyMiles® Gold American Express Card](https://www.americanexpress.com/us/credit-cards/card/delta-skymiles-gold-american-express-card/?eep=25330&intlink=US-Axp-Shop-Consumer-VAC-DeltaGold-Prospect-Viewdetails-CardTile&inav=menu_cards_pc_travelrewardscards) Members can apply and find out their welcome offer which could be as high as 80,000 Bonus Miles plus a $250 Statement Credit as a limited time offer after spending $3,000 in purchases on their new Card in the first six months.*.


- New[Delta SkyMiles® Gold Business American Express Card](https://www.americanexpress.com/en-us/business/credit-cards/delta-skymiles-gold/?linknav=US-Acq-GCP-BusinessCards-ViewAllCards-LearnMore-DeltaGold) Members can earn 90,000 Bonus Miles after spending $6,000 in purchases on their new Card in the first six months.


**Terms and conditions apply. Learn more about the*[Delta SkyMiles® Consumer American Express Cards](https://www.americanexpress.com/us/credit-cards/category/rewards-delta-skymiles/?inav=en_us_menu_cards_personal_cards_view_all_credit_cards&intlink=US-Axp-Shop-Consumer-VAC-CardMember-DeltaSkyMiles-StickyFilter-leftrail-varB) *and*[Delta SkyMiles® Business American Express Cards](https://www.americanexpress.com/us/credit-cards/business/business-credit-cards/airlines/?inav=en_us_menu_cards_business_credit_cards_view_all_business_credit_cards) *.*


## **More reasons to love your Card Membership**


The new welcome offers complement[benefits introduced this summer](https://news.delta.com/more-travel-value-added-delta-skymiles-cards-no-increase-annual-fees) as Delta and American Express celebrated 30 years of partnership. Those updates included a new Second Bag Free benefit for Basic Card Members on domestic Delta-operated flights, a new rideshare credit for Gold Card Members after their first renewal and refreshed Card designs – all with no increase to annual fees. Among them, the Second Bag Free benefit has quickly emerged as a popular new benefit for eligible Card Members.


The enhancements build on the value that Card Members enjoy long after they earn a welcome offer. Here are just a few ways eligible Card Members can get more from their Membership:


Delta x Amex Cobrand


TakeOff 15 is an exciting Card benefit exclusively for Delta SkyMiles® Gold, Gold Business, Platinum, Platinum Business, Reserve and Reserve Business American Express Card Members. Card Members save 15% when booking Award Travel with miles on Delta flights when using delta.com or the Fly Delta app.* Anytime. Terms apply.[Learn more: TakeOff 15 Card Member Discount](https://www.delta.com/us/en/skymiles/airline-credit-cards/takeoff-15)


*Discount not applicable to partner-operated flights or to taxes and fees.


Delta x Amex Cobrand


Delta SkyMiles® Platinum, Platinum Business, Reserve and Reserve Business American Express Card Members receive an MQD Headstart of $2,500 MQDs per Card type each Medallion Qualification Year.


In addition to receiving an MQD Headstart, Card Members can earn MQDs with MQD Boost. This is a way to get closer to Medallion Status for the next Medallion year by earning MQDs when you make everyday purchases on your eligible Delta SkyMiles American Express Card. Learn more:[How to Get Medallion Status](https://www.delta.com/us/en/skymiles/medallion-program/how-to-qualify)


Delta x Amex Cobrand


Eligible Delta SkyMiles® Reserve and Platinum Card Members with an eligible ticket will be added to the Complimentary Upgrade list, after Delta SkyMiles Medallion Members. Terms apply. Learn more:[Medallion Upgrades](https://www.delta.com/us/en/skymiles/medallion-program/medallion-upgrades)


### **And even more to savor with your Card Membership**


***Did you know?*** Delta SkyMiles Reserve Card Members who add their Card to their Resy profile can unlock special access to participating U.S. Resy restaurants with Global Dining Access by Resy.[Learn how it works here](https://resy.com/global-dining-access?date=2026-08-13&seats=2) . Terms apply.


Plus, from now through Oct. 31, 2026, Delta SkyMiles® American Express Card Members can enjoy one complimentary premium snack of their choice on select flights over 900 miles. To redeem, simply log in to fast, free Delta Sync Wi-Fi on flights where available, look for your offer on the Delta Amex tab, and follow the prompts to redeem. Physical Card required.[Terms apply](https://www.delta.com/us/en/about-delta/sync#terms) . Card Members can also receive a 20% savings in the form of a statement credit using their Card on eligible Delta in-flight purchases of food and beverages.[Terms apply](https://global.americanexpress.com/card-benefits/detail/in-flight-savings/delta-reserve) .


## **Your Card unlocks the moments everyone is talking about**


Card Membership goes beyond travel benefits, bringing Members closer to the people, places and passions they love. For eligible Delta SkyMiles® American Express Card Members, that can mean even earlier or exclusive access to sought-after experiences, elevated on-site touches and more ways to redeem miles for benefits and moments they won’t find anywhere else.


#### **Card Member Collection on SkyMiles Experiences**


From entertainment and fashion to adventure and more, the[Card Member Collection on SkyMiles Experiences](https://www.skymilesexperiences.com/iSynApp/allAuction.action?sid=1101601&pgmode1=catpage&selectedCatId=34946) gives eligible Delta SkyMiles® American Express Card Members access to a collection curated exclusively for them. Card Members can use miles to redeem one-of-a-kind experiences and access opportunities they won't find anywhere else, with new experiences and drops released throughout the year. Be on the lookout for the next collection, dropping in September.


#### **Rolling Stone Residency at Cherry Lane Theatre**


This summer, SkyMiles Members and Delta SkyMiles® American Express Card Members have had the opportunity to experience The Rolling Stone Residency, an exclusive six-show series at New York City's iconic Cherry Lane Theatre that pairs intimate live performances with conversations led by a Rolling Stone editor. Additional shows are still to come throughout 2026, with artists revealed just weeks before each performance.


For eligible Delta SkyMiles® American Express Card Members who redeem their miles through SkyMiles Experiences, the experience goes beyond the show itself, with exclusive on-site perks including dedicated merch, a custom trading card and access to an exclusive dining experience at Cherry Lane's coveted Wild Cherry restaurant.
